newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUMA TO UP PLUSTECH STAKE TO 60 PCT.
newsitem.headline: RAUMA TO UP PLUSTECH STAKE TO 60 PCT.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said on Tuesday it will gradually raise its holding in Finnish R&D company Plustech Oy to about 60 percent from the current 25 percent.
"According to the agreement, Rauma will gradually increase its shareholding in Plustech to about 60 percent," Rauma said in a statement.
Plustech's 1995 net sales were seven million markka, it said.
Plustech will focus on long-term research and applications development as part of Rauma's forestry harvester unit Timberjack's European R&D center, Rauma said.
Majority of Plustech is currently owned by the company's employees, it said.
